primary_sources.title: Enhancement of the Stabilization Efficiency of a Neoclassical Magnetic Island by Modulated Electron Cyclotron Current Drive in the ASDEX Upgrade Tokamak
supports: phase-synchronized modulation can improve stabilization efficiency for a specific rotating magnetic island
does_not_support: a pure sine universally stabilizes arbitrary systems

primary_sources.title: Magnets — ITER official system description

primary_sources.title: Full orbit fast ion transport in perturbed magnetic fields

primary_sources.title: A Diophantine approach to evaluating the robustness of magnetic surfaces
supports: rotational transform and rational structure matter for magnetic-surface robustness
does_not_support: geometric torus alone guarantees ideal-MHD stability
